literal: To himself comparison he who does not have, feet to those who joined except, mental worry removing is difficult.
translation: Except for those who have reached the feet of the one who has no equal, it is difficult to dispel the sorrows of the mind.
modern: தனக்கு நிகர் இல்லாதவனுடைய திருவடிகளைச் சேர்ந்தவர்களுக்கு அல்லாமல், மற்றவர்களுக்கு மனக்கவலையை மாற்றுவது கடினம்.
explanation: This couplet states that true relief from mental anguish comes only from seeking the one who is incomparable. The word 'உவமை' means comparison or equal, highlighting the supreme nature of this entity. 'தாள் சேர்ந்தார்க்கு' refers to those who have surrendered to or reached his feet. Without this connection, the text asserts that removing the mind's inherent worries ('மனக்கவலை') is exceedingly difficult.
